title: Hành lý của tôi chưa tới
pronunciation: han lee koo-ah toy choo toy
summary: Say "My bag did not arrive" with Hành lý của tôi chưa tới, then use the notes below to adjust tone and next steps.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: For travelers, Hành lý của tôi chưa tới is the phrase to keep ready for "My bag did not arrive" in arrival, immigration, baggage, SIM cards, pickup, and airport services. This is for when your bag did not appear on the carousel. It works best when you focus on saying the bag problem first so staff know to check the carousel or baggage desk. After you say it, listen for a baggage-tag request, counter direction, form, or update on where to wait; the next rows help you keep the exchange moving.

sections.title: The standard way
sections.body: Use Hành lý của tôi chưa tới as your first sentence for "My bag did not arrive". This is for when your bag did not appear on the carousel. Leave a short pause after the phrase so the other person can answer with a baggage-tag request, counter direction, form, or update on where to wait. Keep your passport, visa, baggage tag, pickup message, or SIM details visible when staff need to match the phrase to a real item.

sections.title: Why it matters
sections.body: Airport phrases help staff route you to the next counter or service without a long explanation. For "My bag did not arrive", Hành lý của tôi chưa tới helps by saying the bag problem first so staff know to check the carousel or baggage desk. Keep the baggage tag, flight number, and pickup carousel in view while staff check.

sections.title: Traveler insight
sections.body: In Airport Border Arrival, the reply often comes as a baggage-tag request, counter direction, form, or update on where to wait. Say Hành lý của tôi chưa tới once, pause, and watch for the reply before adding another sentence. Keep your passport, visa, baggage tag, pickup message, or SIM details visible when staff need to match the phrase to a real item.
